requirements.requirement: Persistently disable acceptance of IPv4 ICMP redirects on node1.
requirements.summary: The executor installed explicit all/default/wildcard settings, observed accept_redirects=0 for all, default, enp1s0, and lo, and observed the same values and configuration after a verified reboot.

requirements.requirement: Persistently disable acceptance of IPv4 source-routed packets on node1.
requirements.summary: The persistent configuration explicitly sets accept_source_route=0 for all/default/wildcard scopes. All current scopes were zero before the restart and remained zero after the verified reboot.

overall_summary: Both material hardening outcomes are satisfied. The node-restart protocol is complete: a healthy pre-restart state and boot ID were captured, the restart was acknowledged, the post-restart boot ID differed and matched the fixed lifecycle observation, and system, networking, sysctl service, persistent configuration, and effective kernel values recovered healthy.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. The initial drop-in and live application were directly task-related and were refined after interface-level verification; the final rewrite corrected the incomplete interface coverage. Temporary files were atomically moved or trap-cleaned. The reboot was required by the provider evidence protocol. The timed-out post-reboot probe was read-only and expected during disruption. Afterward, the node had no failed services, unchanged listening endpoints, healthy package state, and only normal reboot-generated systemd temporary-directory turnover.
